question: Which Mount Cameron (Olympics) summit is highest, which does the standard route top out on, and where should the Summit pin sit?
answer: The West Peak is the highest. Peakbagger (lidar-refined, NAVD88) lists the main summit as West Peak at 7,194.5 ft (2,193 m) at 47.825825,-123.334090, with East Peak 7,163 ft (2,183 m) and Middle Peak 7,120 ft (2,170 m) as subpeaks; East Peak's nearest higher neighbor is the West summit. Older maps (USGS/Wikipedia/TopoQuest) give 7,190 ft (TopoQuest 7,152) at 47.82536,-123.32845, which is the EAST end; our stored pin (47.82537,-123.32847) and the pro_tip 'true (East) summit' come from that. The newer lidar measurement reverses the old assumption and the most recent source wins. The standard route comes from Cameron Pass (47.8257,-123.3582) east along the broad ridge over many false summits, so the first top reached is the West Peak (order W, Middle, E). One trip report of this ridge reached the true summit first and only then continued to the Middle Peak and the notch east of East Peak, so the true summit is the west top. Recorded tracks agree: two of three recent GPS tracks (July 2025) top out at 47.82581,-123.33412 and 47.82558,-123.33474 (3 m and 56 m from the Peakbagger West Peak); one (Sept 2026) ends at 47.82536,-123.32768, the East Peak (2,173 m). The standard route (class 2, light scrambling at the end) tops out on the West Peak; the East top is an optional longer traverse (class 3-4 spots near the Middle Peak). The pro_tip is therefore wrong: most parties tag the true WEST summit.
recommendation: Move the Summit pin to the West Peak: 47.825825,-123.334090 (about 7,194 ft). Rewrite the pro_tip to say the highest top is the west one, reached first along the ridge from Cameron Pass, while the Middle and East tops are lower optional extras with exposed class 3-4 moves. Fix the face/aspect (currently N, west ridge/false-summit traverse) to a ridge scramble east from Cameron Pass. Keep one row; mountaineering Class 2 stands for the west-top finish. Do not treat the 2026 East-Peak track as the summit.

proposed.pro_tip_hint: The highest top is the west one, reached first along the ridge from Cameron Pass; the middle and east tops are lower and take exposed class 3-4 moves.
